captions.en: You grow twice as tall every day.
The top of your head reaches the second floor.
Length, width and depth each double.

captions.zh: 截面只算宽和厚：4 倍
captions.en: A cross-section counts only width and depth: four times.

captions.zh: 8 倍的体重，压在 4 倍的截面上：每平方厘米，扛两倍
captions.en: Eight times the weight on four times the cross-section: every square centimetre carries twice as much.
Your head reaches the fifth floor.

captions.zh: 5 楼的邻居，我替你道过歉了
captions.en: I have apologised to the fifth-floor neighbour for you.

captions.zh: 两倍，就是今天的你，背着另一个你
captions.en: Twice is you today carrying another you.
On which day do the bones give out?
The full episode does the sums.
